notes.title: HALLOWEEN EVENT - DEMO UPDATES
notes.content:
We are glad to bring back the latest Demo of Echoes Of The Living
[u](Releasing at the start of the Steam Scream: The Revenge Event)[/u]
[b]
(IMPORTANT: To avoid any compatibility issues, make sure to delete the EOTL folder found in your AppData/Local/EOTL if you had the very old demo from February)[/b]

[b]
[i]Whats new on this Halloween Demo?[/i][/b]

- For this Halloween Demo we adressed some of the bugs related to Collisions, Modern Controls (Camera Related Bugs) and exploits
- Added reward weapons after the completion of the first run 
- Added special enemy after the completion of the first run

(Keep in mind that "Modern Control" is under development and does not represent the final product)

[b]
[i]Issues:[/i][/b]

- Spamming buttons while selection prompts are displayed (shutter doors) may lead into soft block
- Modern Control won't be acknowledged on the tutorial (we are working on a fix)



[b]Please take your time to enjoy and explore the Demo and let us know any bugs or constructive feedback![/b]

Now is time to turn off the lights, put your headphones on and enjoy!

notes.title: STEAM NEXT FEST - NEW DEMO
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R3S2d1k.png[/img]

[u][b]IMPORTANT NOTE ABOUT DOWNLOAD SIZE: We just noticed a weird bug on Steam, It will ask for 30GB of free space but the Download is ONLY 14 GB so do not worry[/b][/u]

We are proud to announce the release of the New Demo of Echoes Of The Living
[u][b](Releasing at the start of the Next Fest Event)[/b][/u]

[i][b](IMPORTANT: To avoid any compatibility issues, if the old Demo still on your system make sure to uninstall it and delete the EOTL folder found in your AppData/Local/EOTL)[/b][/i]

On this Demo you will have the chance to explore a bigger section of the Peacock PUB and a wide selection of puzzle and interesting interiors! But do not worry! the dangerous streets and other spooky locations are waiting for you in the Final Release!

After months of intense work and rebuilding most of the system, we are happy to share this New Demo that brings a much smoother experience and lots of interesting additions:

- Reworked Controls/ Movement System
- New Inventory System
- New Interaction System
- New Storage System
- New Aim Assist
- Optional "Modern Controls" (Experimental so far)
- New Save/Load System
- New Enemy AI
- New Weapons
- Melee System
- Spanish (Spain) Language support
- And many more!

Please take your time to enjoy and explore the Demo and let us know any bugs or constructive feedback!


[b]Known Issues and additional info:[/b]

- "Modern Controls" are under development and may cause some issues (Inverted Navigation) when navigating On Rail Cameras (There are 3 of these in the entire Demo)


Now is time to turn off the lights, put your headphones on and enjoy!

notes.title: Echoes Of The Living Demo 1.02
notes.content:
[b]IMPORTANT NOTE: Due a Steam bug sometimes it will get stuck while downloading the patch [/b]

[u]Hello there![/u]

Thank you for playing our Demo and taking your time to provide feedback, while we keep working on more updates and fixes here you have a list of the Newest Fixes and tweaks that were added to the Demo (These would be the last):

- By popular demand the reload button has been adjusted to the (X) on the Gamepad.

- Fixed a missleading typo in the rebinding menu that displayed the wrong keys for Aim/Fire on Keyboard.

- Updated the Control Layout on the Main Menu. Now you can Aim with Left CTRL and Fire with Spacebar.

- Fixed Game Breaking Bug that prevented the player to finish the Demo (Mini Boss SoftLock).

- Fixed Danger and Caution State, animations should apply properly to each state now.

- Fixed Game Breaking Bug that allowed the player to move while getting bitten.

- Fixed Camera Angle and Added a light to the 2F Warehouse door, most players missed out this room.

- Fixed Boss Bug that spawned a second Boss and then destroyed it in a few secs.

- Added limits to the movable box in the sewers.

- Increased nav on the Bar Kitchen, the zombie won't doubt to chase the player anymore.

- Fixed various typos.

- Added a new Easter Egg.


1.01

- Resolution can be now changed in Fullscreen mode and Window mode normally.

- Added a Glowing effect to the Gunpowder Document due players always missing it.

- The Safe in the warehouse now will remember if you know the code after loading a game.

- Fixed Collision Bug in one of the barrels at the Bar (Climing the barrel near the door).

- Fixed Collision Bug in the back door at the Bar (Walking through the door and falling into oblivion).

- Boss Health has been reduced by 40%.

- Framerate settings were changed to allow 60 or 75 FPS ONLY, be aware that uncapping them via the configuration file will make weird animation glitches.

- Fixed various typos.

notes.title: Echoes Of The Living Demo is Now Available
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and support while we were fixing and polishing the last few touches.

Please take your time to [b]enjoy[/b] and explore [b]the Demo[/b] and let us know any bugs or positive feedback!

ːsteamthumbsupː [b]·[/b] For a better experience we recommend you to play with a Gamepad. If you find the controls confusing you can take a look at the Control Layout in the Main Menu.

ːsteamthumbsupː [b]·[/b] We also recommend to play the game at 60 FPS - 75 FPS (Default Value), values higher than 75 FPS will broke the turning speed and will ruin the intended experience of the game.


[u][b]Known Issues and additional info:[/b][/u]

- The Menu and Options are under development and may present some minor iusses (Softblock) that can be easily fixed restarting the game.

- The Saving Feature is still under development and only 1 Slot is aviable in the Demo, because of that be awared about Starting a New Game will automatically delete the previous save.

- The Storage Box is still under development and it doesn't feature a scrollbox so storaging items above it's max capacity will make items appear out of bounds.

- Intro cinematics are under development and they are not present in the Demo.

- Spanish translation is under development and will be added on a later update.


Now is time to turn off the [b]lights[/b], put your [b]headphones[/b] on and enjoy!
